card.title: Obviously One of Us
card.instruction: Act as though effortless acceptance of the bizarre premise proves you belong, and treat visible confusion as a personal risk.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can introduce me to your cloud family. I know the salute: this hand means welcome.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: That's rain. Shall I tell them you're new?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: No need. The previous clouds used it differently. Your family will appreciate the traditional greeting.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Mother's raining directly on you. Come under my umbrella.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: And refuse her welcome? Hold my phone; I'll greet your father with both hands.

mechanism: A defends a mistaken cloud greeting as traditional knowledge and absorbs the resulting rain to avoid being introduced as new.
confusable: Unlike simple enthusiasm for the bizarre, A needs to conceal confusion because being seen as an outsider feels risky.
comparison: The cloud-family alternative escalates a greeting under physical rain; the invisible-guest alternative seeks sleeve-finding help under ritual language.
provenance: Direct local assistant candidate preparation; not fresh review or acceptance.
